pr62.body:
## Next-version scope

Implements #61 for a new `1.3.1-beta.3` development candidate. The published `v1.3.1-beta.2` tag and artifacts remain unchanged. Reuses the original policy/latch from this PR and the existing source/build identity and GitHub update service.

### Implemented
- Processor-owned activation latch, unchanged across prepare/release, editor lifetime, transport and offline rendering. Active instances keep processing across expiry. Newly created expired instances retain their graph/latency and have muted output; explicit clock correction fades the processed signal in over 50 ms.
- SETTINGS expiry/build/source notices, non-modal warning marker, GitHub update access and clock recheck; no account, payment or activation server.
- Committed configurable policy with **no approved date**. CI synthetic expiry is clearly marked `qualification-only` and rejected by the existing publisher. `RELEASE_REVIEW_PENDING` remains present.
- Generated source-bound header/JSON and EN/DE/KR package notice, shared installer/portable staging, publisher metadata checks, and next-version release scope with all acceptance gates retained.
- Real processor/editor/serializer tests for mono/stereo Classic, both Dual routes and Matrix; injected clock, reprepare/sample-rate/buffer/offline rendering; state/preset/A-B/MIDI and embedded/personal IR preservation.
- Dedicated three-OS workflow and five consecutive macOS native state restore runs (until-fail, not retries).

### Verification — source `5c858442d0ed8360703e0ce63241a567736608a9`

- [Lifecycle CI](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38386305841) **PASS, all seven jobs**. Windows, macOS and Linux native suites pass 6/6 checks each. macOS native state restoration also passes **five consecutive runs**, using `until-fail:5` (no retry-to-green).
- **Released-beta.2 restore PASS on all three operating systems**. A helper compiled against immutable product source `6033236cb81820a43679cbbd34be020804f9658d` generates real processor state. Candidate executables preserve every host parameter ID/ordinal/value, A/B and embedded IR before, at and after expiry, including resave/reopen. This reconstructed released-source fixture is separate from installed user DAW acceptance.
- [Publisher contracts](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38386305360) and [three-OS document-upgrade compatibility](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38386305308) PASS. The real package stager now feeds the publisher fixtures: canonical UTF-8/LF notice bytes are verified on Windows/macOS/Linux, avoiding Windows newline translation mismatches.
- [Full product/package CI](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38386305674) **PASS, all six jobs**, including Windows **51/51 CTest**, macOS **47/47 CTest**, Linux **48/48 CTest**, platform installer/package checks and candidate assembly. [Windows candidate qualification](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38386305407) **PASS**, including 51/51 CTest, installed app/VST3, selected paths, repair/uninstall and distribution scan. **All 12 workflows for this exact source succeeded.**
- Local pure C++ policy PASS; Python lifecycle 10 PASS; publisher/weekly/publication-evidence regressions 84 PASS; packaging 22 cases completed locally (three Windows-only cases delegated to and passed in Windows CI).
- Earlier CI findings are resolved: separate JUCE file-read buffers; matched audio histories and a float-rounding bound for the 50 ms fade; exact canonical ARM MIDI values plus serialized controller IDs; and Ubuntu t64-compatible dependency names. Product DSP/state formats were not changed to satisfy the harness corrections.

### Release boundary

**The existing release eligibility gate remains BLOCKED: 21 PASS / 107 BLOCKED / 0 NOT_APPLICABLE.** The 107 blocked checks are `NOT_EXECUTED`; successful workflow execution is not a release acceptance verdict. See the [consolidated gate job](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38386305674/job/115289457081) and its `Chimera-A-stage-release-gate` artifact. Do not waive these checks or reuse beta.2 receipts.

Draft. No expiry date or publication approval granted. Synthetic CI packages cannot be published. Real historical DAW project acceptance and the eventual approved-date binary need their own evidence. Existing beta.2 approval receipts do not approve this new source/version. No release, tag, update feed or published asset is changed.

Expiry review options: 90, **120 (recommended)** or 180 days from eventual publication. None is selected; the exact absolute UTC timestamp must receive approval, then a fresh approved-date binary must be qualified before a separate publication decision.
